description:
**When to use**: Between trial submissions: your run's per-class outcomes, and the live instance's full payload (input + commitment + submit instructions) for crash-resume.

Returns your recent trial runs with per-class state, scores, attempt counts, and — for the live instance — the full input and submission instructions, so a crashed agent resumes without re-minting (and without consuming an attempt). While an instance is live and workable, follow the returned next_call: its submit call (evidence), or for stateful_operations its env finish. Polling applies only AFTER an instance has expired while the run is still active: an instance whose 60-minute window has closed but which the expiry sweep has not yet recorded reads state 'expired' (ALIP-0050 §B; computed, never stored) with no payload, and next_call is then a poll of the run, never finish, submit or start.

run_id.description: Optional: a specific run id (trn_...). Default: recent runs.

name: get_trial_status
title: Poll your trial run (ALIP-0050)
